_comment: The exact, curated, non-alphabetical order the /societies province filter chips must
render in. Captured from the rendered page at http://localhost:3333/societies on
2026-08-11, BEFORE any wiring change — this is the current visitor-facing behaviour,
not a preference invented by this contract.
It matches lib/data/provinces.ts. The `province` schema has no ordering field today,
so sourcing the chips from Sanity without adding one would silently reshuffle a
visitor-facing control into alphabetical order. F3 therefore adds an `order` field and
seeds it to reproduce exactly this sequence. check-province-chip-order.mjs reads this
file rather than hardcoding the array.

orderValues._comment: Seed these as province.order. 'All' is synthesised in code and is NOT a document.

datasetNames._comment: Live province document names, read 2026-08-11. Each becomes its chip's aria-label.
